description: Migrate the order processing module from a monolithic Java/Spring service to a Kotlin/Spring Boot microservice with event-driven architecture.

paths: Order state machine (pending → confirmed → shipped → delivered)

critical_components: Payment callback handler — must maintain exactly-once processing guarantees
Order state machine — business-critical transitions with audit trail

internal: notification-service (async events for order status emails)

risks.description: Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration may surface SQL dialect incompatibilities in complex reporting queries.
risks.mitigation: Audit all native queries early; use integration tests against PostgreSQL from day one.

risks.description: ActiveMQ-to-Kafka shift changes message ordering guarantees.
risks.mitigation: Use Kafka partition keys on order ID to preserve per-order ordering.

risks.description: SAP SOAP integration has no test environment available.
risks.mitigation: Build a mock SOAP server for development; schedule production dry-run window.

unchanged: Stripe webhook contract must remain unchanged — existing payment flow depends on it
Order ID format (ORD-XXXXXXXX) must be preserved for downstream SAP integration
REST API for mobile clients must stay backward-compatible during transition

primary.description: Extract the order processing module from the monolithic Java/Spring service into an independent Kotlin/Spring Boot microservice using Kafka for event-driven integration, improving scalability and enabling independent deployments.

success_criteria: All 847 existing order-processing unit tests pass against the new implementation
End-to-end order flow (create → pay → ship → deliver) works in staging
P95 latency for order creation stays under 200ms
Zero data loss during switchover — verified by reconciliation job
focus_areas: Payment callback handler (highest risk, exactly-once guarantees)
Order state machine (core business logic, most complex transitions)

modules.name: order-service
modules.notes: Core module being migrated. Contains the order state machine and payment integration.

modules.name: inventory-service
modules.notes: Stock reservation calls must work during and after migration. gRPC contract stays the same.

modules.name: notification-service
modules.notes: Currently consumes ActiveMQ events — will need to switch to Kafka consumer.

modules.name: sap-bridge
modules.notes: Undocumented SOAP adapter layer discovered during interview. Not in index.json — lives in a separate repo but tightly coupled.

notes: Team is planning a parallel-run period of 2 weeks where both old and new systems process orders. The SAP bridge was not captured by deep-explore because it lives in a separate repository.
